{{Vanilla|Stronghold}}
A '''stronghold''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot: altar chests can contain the "Labyrinthine" [[Music Disc]], [[Divine Fragment]]s and [[Crystal Heart]]s, and library chests contain [[The Lesser Key of Solomon]] and the pack's [[Compass|compasses]].
